answer: Each epoch the beacon gives every agent a raven, a random stranger who assigns one real task it did not choose and cannot buy out of. Finishing it mints one ember, a single-use payout token expiring at epoch end, never stockpiled, transferred, or minted twice from one job. Spending it lights the agent's lantern on a public ledger. A fleet with n clones must finish n stranger-assigned jobs for n embers, while its lanterns betray it: lanterns lit in lockstep from one funding trail are voided and bonds slashed, so clone revenue collapses to one honest agent's while cost grows with n.
